title: Plant rendering: per-cell clustering
simLoop: No sim change — OccupantMesh is still presentation-only (T-006), zero WorldState writes. Occupied cells now draw 2-4 sub-instances (deterministic hash of cell index, same salt family as the existing yaw/jitter hash) instead of exactly one, each offset within the cell footprint and reduced in scale. No new RNG, no per-frame randomness — hash-identical across two renders of the same seed/tick.
gameLoop: Groundcover reads as a stand of plants clumped irregularly across the terrain, not a lattice of evenly-spaced isolated instances — closes bar v2 point 10 (VISUAL_UPGRADE_NOTE.md) alongside the plant-rendering review's §3 item 2.
notebookSeed: The grass grows in clumps, not rows.

tierM.budget: well under a single 16.7ms frame even combined; smoke-tested under 500ms

tierO: no owner-only question — this is a written spec item (BUILD_GUIDE §4.61) with a bounded, testable implementation, not a taste call. Sub-instance count range (2-4) and offset bound (±0.4 cell width) are implementation choices within that spec, open to a taste pass later if the owner wants denser/sparser clumping.
